description: Audit an EXISTING page (yours or a client's — any AI builder, any stack) for the default-AI "section grammar" tell: numbered steps, a centered hero with two buttons, 3-up icon cards, a testimonial/FAQ/CTA-band skeleton repeating unchanged. Deterministic, no LLM — every finding cites the exact matched HTML. Returns an ai_shaped_score (0-100), per-section tells with evidence, page-level tells (skeleton order, uniform scaffolding, default type/motion), and prescriptions: real Motion Menu patterns to replace each flagged section, drawn from the same graph recommend_patterns/validate_combination use, plus the exact next tool calls to fetch and validate them. FREE, no key required.

html.description: the page's full HTML — one page per call; a multi-page site is the caller's own loop

url.description: alternative to html — fetched server-side (https only, public addresses only, 3 MB cap, 10 s timeout, no redirect to a private range, no credentials forwarded)

name: audit_page
